headline: Holy Family win their first match of the season
dek: Holy Family had not played a match this season until the one at Caldwell, and they won it. Two goals scored and one conceded is the whole of their record, and it puts them level on points with four sides who have been playing since August.
displaced_by: Holy Family's first match of the season, a win at Caldwell

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Georgian Court's nineteen goals are more than Dominican, Holy Family and Post have scored between them, yet they have conceded fifteen: the conference's scoring is concentrated in one side, and its defending is not.

wire.line: Holy Family have played their first match of the season and won it; no other side in the conference is still unbeaten.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Post have won four, drawn two and lost two; the win over Chestnut Hill lifts their goals scored to eleven, against eight conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Caldwell have scored eleven and conceded fourteen; the defeat to Holy Family is their fourth, beside three wins and no draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chestnut Hill have lost five, won two and drawn two; the defeat at Post takes their goals conceded to eighteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jefferson's six defeats remain the most in the conference, beside one win and no draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Max Bond has made 49 saves for Chestnut Hill and conceded fifteen, a save percentage of .766.

last_match.line: Holy Family's first match of the season; Caldwell have still not drawn a match.

next_match.line: Georgian Court have scored in every match but their last; Felician have not won since August.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
